top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock is one identifiable idea (the magic-wavelength lattice) realised at the 10^-18 level, reproduced and surpassed in Sr, Yb and Hg laboratories, with demonstrated many-body and millimetre-scale redshift physics. The Katori and Ye allocation matches the record of invention and development, and a citation limited to what has been shown is defensible. This is clearly preferable to no award, despite the category and overlap concerns with the 2005 and 2012 prizes.
